description: The remainder with two negative operands is negative
notes: The spec calls % the remainder (modulo) without saying which sign the result takes. hashicorp/hcl computes a - b * trunc(a / b), so the result takes the sign of the dividend (Value.Modulo in cty/value_ops.go). For -7 % -3 truncated and floored remainders both give -1, and only a Euclidean remainder, which is never negative, gives 2, so this test tells a Euclidean remainder apart.
